content: OAuth PKCE flow: app/auth/callback/route.ts is a GET Route Handler that reads ?code= (and an optional ?next= redirect target) from the URL, creates a server Supabase client bound to the request/response cookies, and calls supabase.auth.exchangeCodeForSession(code) which sets the session cookie via the SSR cookie adapter, then redirects to the app (onboarding or dashboard). Known gotcha: in some supabase-js versions the SIGNED_IN event that writes cookies fires via setTimeout(0), which can race with the response in serverless — pin a known-good @supabase/ssr version and verify cookies are set before redirecting.
